title: SLA & automation
subtitle: Service level targets, auto-assignment and escalation rules.

policies.intro: Response and resolution targets per priority. The most specific active policy applies to each ticket.
policies.scopeHint: Leave category and department empty to apply to all tickets.
policies.businessHoursHint: SLA time only counts during the working days and hours below.
policies.calendarHint: SLA time counts around the clock, every day.
policies.targetsHint: Enable the priorities this policy covers. Resolution must not be shorter than first response.
policies.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Tickets that already have due dates keep them.

assignment.intro: Rules are checked in order; the first active rule that matches a new ticket is applied.
assignment.conditionsHint: All filled conditions must match. Leave everything empty to match every ticket.
assignment.keywordHint: Matches when the ticket subject or description contains this text.
assignment.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Existing ticket assignments are not changed.

escalation.intro: Escalation rules run automatically when a ticket nears or breaches its SLA or waits too long.
escalation.reassignHint: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current assignee.

strategyHint.None: The ticket is left unassigned (department and priority changes still apply).
strategyHint.SpecificAgent: Always assign to the selected agent.
strategyHint.RoundRobin: Rotate between available agents in turn.
strategyHint.LeastLoaded: Assign to the agent with the fewest open tickets.

triggerHint.SlaWarning: Runs when an SLA target is about to be missed.
triggerHint.SlaBreached: Runs when an SLA target has been missed.
triggerHint.Unassigned: Runs when a ticket stays unassigned longer than the delay.
triggerHint.NoAgentReply: Runs when the customer waits longer than the delay for an agent reply.

validation.noWorkDays: Select at least one working day.
validation.hoursOrder: Work end must be after work start.
validation.noTargets: Enable at least one priority target.
validation.resolutionBeforeFirst: Resolution time must not be shorter than first response time.
validation.firstTooLong: First response can be at most 60 days.
validation.resolutionTooLong: Resolution can be at most 365 days.
validation.afterTooLong: The delay can be at most 30 days.
